QuestInfo.name: [Carcion] Supporting the Scouts
QuestInfo.0: The Turtle scouts have been attacked by Snakes. Join with the Turtles and head to Carcion's jungle region, #bLaguna#k, to support them.
QuestInfo.1: Defeat the Specters and help the Turtle scouts.
QuestInfo.2: You faced the #bSnake Anima#k who attacked the Turtle scouts. But when the Snakes saw you and the other Alliance members, they retreated. Why?

0.msg: The High Flora forces are blocking the way to the scouts. Clear the path!
